newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek equities rebound with convincing gains.
newsitem.headline: Greek equities rebound with convincing gains.

text.p: Greek equities regained composure rebounding to higher ground after a non-committal open as the benchmark share index climbed 7.09 points or 0.77 percent in moderate turnover ahead of a long weekend.
Monday October 28 is a market holiday.

"Today's reaction confirmed again that a nervous reaction to the upside is quite easy for the market -- a reminder to the bears. Construction shares were strong and climbed again," said analyst Emmanuel Varsos at Investment Analysis.

"Today's lesson is that there are hidden buyers out there who at any time can push this market higher. Right now they are looking for bargains -- liquidations of overextended long positions by those who, like it or not, have to comply with the recent investment services law by November 1," he said.
Selling pressure could reappear next week but it will be completing its cycle. Moreover, blue chip shares were showing a marked rise in trading volume and this should not go unnoticed, Varsos said.
The Athens general share index closed up 0.77 percent or 7.09 points higher at 922.58. Gainers led losers 134 to 77 with 33 issues unchanged.
